title: Hooks called after an early return
reason: All five useState calls precede the conditional return; moving that return above them would be unsafe.

title: Telegram webhook uses non-constant-time comparison
reason: The imported helper calls hmac.compare_digest on encoded bytes.

title: Crash between job creation and payment completion loses money forever
reason: The retry skips the completed-payment return for a pending payment, reuses the job and completes the payment. This does not prove all concurrent scenarios.

title: Provider retries can double-grant Fix Packs
reason: The report itself acknowledges grant idempotency. A possible duplicate notification does not prove a duplicate grant.

title: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL exposes API endpoint to client
reason: The browser calls this API. Visibility of its URL alone is not a credential leak or an authorization bypass.

title: 990.00 becomes 989.999 and rejects a paid order
reason: The cited two-decimal formatting returns 990.00 and 990.07 for those inputs. Broader money handling still needs its own tests.
